// upgrade_from: the installed versions this package upgrades, both inclusive and optional
// upgrader: the oldest upgrade tool (synodepy3) that installs this package
// config_picks: The configuration files an upgrade makes of this package's file (the template) and the installed values of the fields listed: {file: {field: [the names it ever had, the newest first]}} (semanticshare ConfigPicks). Everything else is the new version's: new fields, default values, renamed types. A file not listed is kept as installed.
